intro: One bowl of bubur jagung is about 250 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the corn, santan and sugar.
diet: Yes, as a dessert or snack. Bubur jagung is high in carbs and sugar, but very low in protein. Half a bowl is usually enough to satisfy your sweet tooth.
tips: Take half a bowl, especially after a heavy meal.
Cook your own with less sugar and thinner santan.
Don't use it to replace a main meal.

swap.name: 1 boiled corn on the cob
swap.why: Real corn taste without added santan and sugar, plus more fibre.

faq.q: What is bubur jagung made of?
faq.a: Usually creamed corn or corn kernels, santan, sugar and a bit of sago or cornflour to thicken it.

faq.q: Is bubur jagung good for buka puasa?
faq.a: Yes, it's a popular sweet treat at Ramadan bazaars. Have a small portion after your main meal.

faq.q: Can I use milk instead of santan?
faq.a: Yes. Low-fat milk makes it lighter but still creamy.
